mapper.sql: id, session_id, attempt_no, user_response, expected_response, is_correct, independent, hint_used, score, feedback, evaluation_json, created_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO practice_attempt (session_id, attempt_no, user_response, expected_response, is_correct, independent, hint_used, score, feedback, evaluation_json) VALUES (#{sessionId}, #{attemptNo}, #{userResponse}, #{expectedResponse}, #{isCorrect}, #{independent}, #{hintUsed}, #{score}, #{feedback}, #{evaluationJson})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM practice_attempt WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} ORDER BY attempt_no ASC, id ASC

SELECT pa.id, pa.session_id, pa.attempt_no, pa.user_response, pa.expected_response, pa.is_correct, pa.independent, pa.hint_used, pa.score, pa.feedback, pa.evaluation_json, pa.created_at FROM practice_attempt pa INNER JOIN practice_session ps ON pa.session_id = ps.id WHERE ps.memory_id = #{memoryId} ORDER BY pa.created_at ASC, pa.id ASC
